def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(v for r in g for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    nz=[i for i,row in enumerate(g) if any(v!=bg for v in row)]
    tb,bb=nz[0],nz[-1]
    A=g[tb][next(j for j,v in enumerate(g[tb]) if v!=bg)]
    tcols=[j for j,v in enumerate(g[tb]) if v==A]
    bcols=[j for j,v in enumerate(g[bb]) if v==A]
    cells=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j] not in (bg,A)]
    B=g[cells[0][0]][cells[0][1]]
    cs={j for _,j in cells}
    # direction: toward the bar whose columns are closest to the shape columns
    dt=min(abs(c-tc) for c in cs for tc in tcols)
    db=min(abs(c-bc) for c in cs for bc in bcols)
    down = db<=dt
    def beam(c, start, dr):
        i=start
        while 0<=i<h and g[i][c]!=A:
            yield i; i+=dr
    o=[r[:] for r in g]
    beams=[]
    for r,c in cells:
        beams.append((c, r+(1 if down else -1), 1 if down else -1))
    shift = (bcols[0]-tcols[0]) if not down else (tcols[0]-bcols[0])
    for c in cs:

        if 0<=c2<w:
            beams.append((c2, tb+1 if down else bb-1, 1 if down else -1))
    for c,start,dr in beams:
        for i in beam(c,start,dr): o[i][c]=B
    for r,c in cells: o[r][c]=4
    return o

lib = '''"""Reusable ARC helpers: background detection and beam/extrusion painting."""

from collections import Counter


def background(grid):
    """Most common color in the grid."""
    return Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]


def content_rows(grid, bg):
    """Indices of rows containing any non-background color."""
    return [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if any(v != bg for v in row)]


def bar_cells(grid, bg, row):
    """Columns and color of the non-background cells in one row (a bar)."""
    cols = [j for j, v in enumerate(grid[row]) if v != bg]
    return cols, grid[row][cols[0]]


def shape_cells(grid, bg, bar_color):
    """Cells (i, j) that are neither background nor bar color, and their color."""
    cells = [(i, j) for i, row in enumerate(grid) for j, v in enumerate(row)
             if v not in (bg, bar_color)]
    return cells, (grid[cells[0][0]][cells[0][1]] if cells else None)


def paint_beams(grid, beams, color, stop_color):
    """Cast beams in place: each beam is (col, start_row, step); paint color along
    it until a stop_color cell or the grid edge is hit."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    for c, start, step in beams:
        i = start
        while 0 <= i < h and grid[i][c] != stop_color:
            grid[i][c] = color
            i += step
    return grid
